answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 57762 Country: United States of America Title: Wazifah for baby boy Question: Is there any wazifah to be read during pregnancy for a baby boy? Answer ID: 57762 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 263/238/H=04/1436) Recite the first ruku of Surah Maryam after each salah as well as before going to bed. Also read Durood extensively, at least four tasbih (400 times) daily. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
